messages.subject: SEM with nested data, mediators and catergorical data
parts:
Hi everyone,

I've never used the Lavaan package on R and I was wondering if it could help me to fit a model I'm working on.

I have data from students and I would like to replicate an hypothesis correlating my categorical IV to 3 different categorical DVs. I want to see if several mediators can also explain this link and if some covariate influence the DVs. The participants are nested within neighborhood so I need to use a multilevel approach.

Here is a graphical version of the model:

Thanks in advance, that's really important,


Jordane

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: SEM with nested data, mediators and catergorical data
parts: I want to see if several mediators can also explain this link and if some covariate influence the DVs.

The tutorial shows you how to specify regression paths in a path model:

http://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/syntax1.html
The participants are nested within neighborhood so I need to use a multilevel approach.

Multilevel SEM is not yet available in lavaan. If you are only interested in student-level effects and simply need to account for the clustering effect, then you can use the lavaan.survey package to correct the SEs of the (population-average) estimates.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
